purpose: Revised overworld camera concept based on user screenshot; concept only
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 16:9 gameplay-view concept for Project Kingdom. Input image 1 is the PRIMARY CAMERA, composition, world scale, simplified stylized 3D rendering and open traversable landscape reference. Input image 2 is ONLY the identity/outfit of the cat hero. Match image 1's distant third-person elevated camera very closely: horizon around upper quarter, broad ground stretching across most of the screen, a TINY controllable character near horizontal center at 68 percent image height. Cat plus frog mount combined must occupy ONLY 8 to 10 percent of the entire image height. See the rider from BEHIND travelling away into the landscape; no close-up, no posing toward viewer, no huge foreground character. Subject: tiny chibi orange tabby adventurer with red scarf, ivory shirt, olive trousers, brown backpack, sword SHEATHED, riding a friendly round green frog with a simple leather saddle. Frog in a grounded forward hopping/walking stride along an open grassy track. World: change the reference desert into our lush green Mosswood region, with generous open rolling grassy hills shaped like the reference's smooth dune formations, scattered rounded tree clusters, small rock outcrops, a blue river winding through the mid-distance, a stone bridge and a MINIATURE town of cream houses and blue roofs tucked at left middle-distance, distant blue-green plateau mountains and brilliant blue sky with soft clouds. Gentle rounded-world curvature and terrain disappearing naturally toward horizon, no planet outline or floating island. Preserve the reference's sense of large walkable space and collectible-scale scenery, low visual clutter and toy-like JRPG overworld scale. Actual stylized 3D game screenshot aesthetic inspired by Ni no Kuni overworld, simple rounded geometry, hand-painted textures, warm cel shaded lighting, broad readable colors and soft shadows. Do not make a detailed realistic landscape painting. Optional compact circular parchment minimap at upper right containing the SAME green region, blue river, road and tiny red player arrow; no other HUD, no readable text, no logos, no watermark. No desert, no extra party members, no human hero. The camera distance and the tiny rear-facing mounted character are the most important constraints.
